resources.string: Zero-background dynamic session & in-app Cronet/gRPC quota HUD for Gemini (account-switch safe, MIUIX/MD3, EN/CN)
Live Capsule Preview (Dynamic Session + Foreground-Only HUD)
Foreground Hook Ready · Engine: %1$s\nHost: %2$s (woke %3$ds ago) · Zero Background Services
Waiting for Gemini foreground launch:\n• Enable Gemini-Eye in LSPosed / Vector for Gemini, then open Gemini.\n• HUD attaches strictly on Gemini foreground and sleeps completely in background.

Dynamic Session & Zero-Background Lifecycle: intercepts live Authorization / Cookie / X-Goog-AuthUser headers on outgoing Cronet & gRPC requests for seamless Google account switching, refreshes only on app open or query send, and runs 0 background services.
